operation.description:
Deleting a repository requires admin access.

If an organization owner has configured the organization to prevent members from deleting organization-owned
repositories, you will get a `403 Forbidden` response.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `delete_repo` scope to use this endpoint.

403.description: If an organization owner has configured the organization to prevent members from deleting organization-owned repositories, a member will get this response:

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
